# EC49FPG — Two complete original BRC domains: invisible gauges and an exact one-coordinate repair

**2026-11-15. Status: AUTHOR_PROVED / EXACT_FINITE_CHECKED / NOT_REVIEWED.** Independent portable mathematical research; no claim of a native Task, CLAIM, Result, Review or P000 promotion.

## Exact scientific source and operator

Frozen scientific input is `awdawmip/enterprise-math@fc0f038e7bfd12c886b4d37f900bfb770c0f61ab`. Original source SHA256: `cd9a50799536d2b96230777b5392b1d742ceee896da05bb49aa097cf351e1d5e`. The input has 94 word families, 178850 source words, 38169 original configurations, 24 demand labels, and named roots 03, 05, 06, 07. There are exactly 625 distinct complete 24-label eligible-root-domain classes. The original byte-prefix Trie root-cost operator and signed/named root identities are preserved.

For configuration K, root r and admissible optional demand subset S, define the **exact integer** root cost P_K(r,S) as the minimum original Trie prefix-cover cost of the mandatory r-demands and the specified optional r-demands. A legal complete allocation q assigns each optional label to exactly one eligible root. Its terminal cost is

`T_K(q) = sum_{r in {03,05,06,07}} P_K(r,S_r(q)).`

Every quantifier below ranges over one **entire original eligible-root-domain class**; no terminal observation is permitted to inspect a hidden root's separate cost.

## Theorem A: class of original configuration 16943

The entire original class has 310 configurations, 84 named-root/subset integer-cost coordinates per configuration, and 144 legal complete allocation actions. There are **141** distinct complete rooted P profiles and **139** distinct complete terminal T profiles. Among all C(310,2)=47895 unordered source configuration pairs:
- 1689 pairs have P_K=P_K';
- 1691 pairs have T_K=T_K';
- **exactly two pairs are terminal-equal but rooted-different**, listed below.

The exact two witness pairs, with the second minus first root-cost difference on **every allowed subset at each named root**, are:

| Pair of source configuration IDs | ΔP_03 | ΔP_05 | ΔP_06 | ΔP_07 | ΔT on every legal allocation |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| (17928, 38165) | 0 | -4 | +4 | 0 | 0 |
| (24541, 38166) | 0 | -2 | +2 | 0 | 0 |

**Algebraic nullspace lemma.** If ΔP_r(S)=c_r is independent of the allowed subset S at each named root, and Σ_r c_r=0, then ΔT(q)=0 for every legal allocation q. These two realizable witnesses instantiate the lemma. The complete 310-source-pair exact enumeration establishes that they are the *only* terminal-invisible nonzero rooted contrasts within this finite source class; the lemma by itself is a sufficient condition, not a claimed global characterization of the BRC observer kernel.

An explicit fixed set of **four** zero-based terminal queries `(64,140,72,31)` gives 139 distinct response signatures for all 139 terminal-equivalence classes. No terminal-only strategy, even adaptive and using arbitrarily many of the 144 allocation actions, can distinguish both witness pairs and thus cannot identify all 141 rooted profiles.

**Exact minimal one-coordinate gauge repair.** Augment the above four terminal queries with **one independent named-root baseline observation `P_K(05, empty_optional_subset)`**. These five scalar readouts give **141 distinct signatures**, exactly one per rooted profile among all 310 sources. A terminal-only observer requires at least one added nonterminal coordinate, since the two explicit witnesses are terminal-indistinguishable; one named-root baseline suffices. This minimizes the *count of added named-root measurements*, not the total terminal query count.

## Theorem B: class of original configuration 16995

The complete class has 242 configurations, 96 rooted cost coordinates per configuration and 324 legal complete allocations. The partitions induced by P and T coincide on the entire class: each has **112** distinct profiles and exactly **1791** equal unordered source pairs among C(242,2)=29161. Hence there is no nonzero rooted contrast invisible to the complete terminal observer in this class.

An explicit six-query zero-based fixed terminal observer `(92,190,47,4,80,9)` yields 112 distinct response signatures for all 112 rooted profiles. Neither its size 6 nor the class-16943 size 4 is claimed minimal.

## Complete finite proof / verification

The attached independent exact verifier reconstructs the eligible-root signatures of all 38169 original configurations and verifies the partition into 625 domains before extracting **every source configuration** of classes 16943 (310) and 16995 (242). The frozen original C++17 byte-prefix Trie code independently compiled at `-O2` and `-O3` emitted **49272 identical exact integer rooted-cost records**, SHA256 of the CSV in either compilation: `a61a3ee4d2f13f9d216f52cd3529c72d395c1250bfb1d7ae96a1adf5a6837c1f`.

Using integer arithmetic, the verifier computed all **123048** terminal costs: `310*144+242*324=123048`. It exhaustively classified all **77056** within-class unordered configuration pairs, proved `P_equal=3480`, `T_equal=3482`, and checked exactly two nonzero terminal-invisible source pairs. It evaluated and checked all named-root offsets for **every reachable subset**, independently rebuilt the Trie via a separate Python byte-DP for eight configurations including all four gauge endpoints, and checked injectivity of the explicit terminal observer and augmented named-root observer sets.

**Finite proof semantics:** These are complete exact integer results on two explicitly named full source-domain classes of the pinned original corpus. P000/Heartbeat native X6 and branch provenance are unaffected. This result is not a physical time-evolution or asymptotic theorem. Mathematical independent review is pending.

## Reproduction and provenance

Run `python VERIFY_EC49FPG.py EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY`, where the evidence directory contains `frozen_original_master.txt` and `EC49FPG_PROFILE.csv`. Verify the source and cost CSV SHA256 listed above. The complete immutable-input package for this research turn is `EC49FPG_TWO_DOMAINS_GAUGE_EVIDENCE_20261115.tar.xz`, SHA256 `f053318c84346a5785217a4daf94f15125eb16b602668ea83a8e421124077cae`, containing original frozen input, C++17 source, both independent optimization-result CSV files, full Python verifier, exact machine certificate with source members, execution results and checksums. The evidence package is provided as a conversation artifact; the text, statement, source pins and checker are persisted here in the project GitHub branch.

The prior corpus accounting was **563 of 625 classes completed** in [EC49FPF PR #2469](https://github.com/awdawmip/enterprise-math/pull/2469); this turn classifies two additional domains. Subject to concurrent project-wide work, the cumulative accounting becomes **565 completed, 60 remaining**. That accounting is secondary to the exact class certificates.

**Next scientific questions:** Search among other full original domains for subset-dependent (rather than constant-root) terminal-invisible contrasts; find the minimum terminal-query count **given** one named-root baseline for class 16943; determine whether the class-16995 six-query construction is optimal, and its optimal adaptive depth. Preserve original rooted cost semantics and observer distinction.
